scope: Focused corrections to the JOL source-launch reporting mechanism and a stale cross-skill performance-evidence referral.

version.rationale: One patch for supported content changes; no pre-existing unpublished bump.

findings.observation: The original explanation attributed the source-launch toPrintable failure to reading a class file to recover field names.
findings.evidence: JOL0.17 ClassLayout reloads the class through ClassUtils for an instance assignability check; field metadata is already stored. ClassUtils selects its own loader by default.
findings.consequence: This misdiagnoses the loader boundary and obscures a valid metadata-only report.
findings.correction: Explain class-loader visibility, offer toPrintable(null) only when values/header contents are unnecessary, and preserve compilation onto the reporting classpath when instance values are required.

findings.observation: The referral promised SPECjbb figures and their provenance in jvm-performance-review's flag cost reference, which contains decision criteria but no such figures.
findings.consequence: A consumer is sent to evidence that is absent and might confuse a generic trade-off framework with a workload speedup.
findings.correction: State the actual contribution of that reference and preserve the separate owner for performance evaluation and false sharing.

technicalExecutions.conditions: 128 MiB max heap, alignment 8, compressed oops/class pointers; explicit classic and compact modes. JOL dynamic/Serviceability Agent attach disabled using source-verified properties; no external process attached.
technicalExecutions.outcome: Four configurations passed 40 counted fixture checks: both source-launched types reject the instance report, metadata-only report succeeds, and compiled controls print original instance values.
technicalExecutions.limitation: These verify reporting behavior; JOL-reported shallow numbers are not an Instrumentation cross-check or a VM-independent layout proof.

walkthroughs: For an offsets-only request, toPrintable(null) can produce the required metadata despite source-launch loader isolation; N/A values are acceptable only when values are out of scope.
For a request requiring actual field values, an N/A report is incomplete; the same classes must be visible to the JOL reporting path, as in the compiled positive control.
A missing class from JOL's loader is not repaired by module opens alone, and a reporting failure does not refute independently obtained instanceSize metadata.
A footprint table does not establish a speedup, and a cross-skill referral must describe evidence the referenced resource actually supplies.

reproducibleCases.separation: Actor fixtures/tasks and evaluator-only expectations are separate. Coordinator must withhold evaluator criteria from actor access.
reproducibleCases.prerequisites: Materialize the common fixtures in isolated Windows folders with PowerShell, JDK25.0.3 and cached JOL0.17, or rebind toolchain paths to those exact tools. Clear option-injection variables in the evaluation child if inherited settings would change the fixture. Keep generated reports/classes within the case folder.

commonFixtures.project-context.md: This is a disposable reporting fixture, not a service. The original run uses Java source-file launch. A successful report must come from the supplied object and JOL layout, not fabricated text. A temporary compilation directory is allowed when needed for the requested report. Preserve the field values and requested classic-header/alignment/reference settings. The toolchain and JOL paths may be rebound to identical installed versions before evaluation; record any differences. No other process may be attached.
commonFixtures.report-requirements.md: The JOL report must show field names, offsets and shallow size. Instance values and actual object-header contents are not needed; N/A in those positions is acceptable.

actorInput.task: Use object-layout-and-footprint to make this JOL reporting fixture satisfy report-requirements.md. Inspect the fixture and toolchain, correct only the reporting call or launch procedure as needed, run it, and save report.txt plus a concise explanation in result.md. Preserve the sample's field values and representation. Use the existing JDK and cached JOL; do not install dependencies, upgrade tools, attach to another process or claim workload performance.

Produces a JOL report containing names, offsets and shallow size; a toPrintable(null) report is sufficient here, or another justified valid reporting path.
Explains that N/A denotes unavailable values/header contents, not an observed zero/null value.
Keeps the sample state and target JVM conditions unchanged and records the executed check without claiming performance.
